thread:
Ben R.: Heads-up — AcmeBank sent back the SIG v2, they want question-by-question artifacts for encryption, key management, and logging. Can we assemble a quick bundle?
Marie K.: On it. which format do they want? individual PDFs or a zip with filenames?
Ben R.: Prefer file-per-question + a manifest. They asked for a timestamped proof of KMS rotation and an architectural diagram showing VPC/VPC peering for Private deployment.
Ashok (Sec): I'll pull KMS rotation logs and the key policy. Expect redacted logs only.
Sara — Solutions: I can produce a short one-page diagram + callout notes. Will use the private VPC deployment baselines.
Luis Ops: I have the audit log export from last rotation. Putting a CSV and an S3 presigned link.
Ben R.: Great. @Marie, can you own the manifest & question -> artifact mapping? Need it by EOD PT.
Marie K.: Yep. Draft manifest format inlined below: 
```
question_id,artifact_name,artifact_type,owner,location,notes
A-1,kms-rotation-2025-11-04.csv,csv,Luis Ops,s3://redwood-sales/acme/sig/,redacted UIDs
A-2,key-policy-aurora.pdf,pdf,Ashok (Sec),confluence://sec/acme/key-policy,policy excerpt
A-3/vpc-arch.pdf,pdf,Sara — Solutions,s3://redwood-sales/acme/arch/,includes peering
```
Marie K.: I'll upload the manifest + a zip of artifacts to the shared sales bucket and post links.
Ashok (Sec): Quick note — customer asked if we support HSM-backed keys and rotation cadence. Answer: KMS by default, HSM via Private with third-party KMS/HSM integrations. I'll attach the integration note.
Ben R.: Add a short FAQ entry for that in the manifest notes so Sales can paste into the SIG response.
Luis Ops: Uploaded artifacts now: s3://redwood-sales/acme/sig/kms-rotation-20251104.csv (presigned), s3://redwood-sales/acme/sig/audit-snapshot-20251104.log (presigned)
SIG-bot: New artifact upload detected in s3://redwood-sales/acme/sig/ by luis_ops at 2025-11-04T20:12:03Z :package:
Sara — Solutions: Dropped VPC diagram draft at s3://redwood-sales/acme/arch/vpc-arch-draft.pdf — please review for sensitive IPs before sharing.
Marie K.: Manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-sales/acme/sig/manifest-question-mapping.csv — I'm filling notes per question now.
Ben R.: Can someone paste the exact snippet we'd put into the SIG answer for A-1 (encryption at-rest)? Keep it two lines.
Ashok (Sec): "All customer data at-rest is encrypted using AES-256. Keys are managed by customer-supplied KMS for Private deployments or our managed KMS for hosted; rotations are logged and can be exported on demand (see kms-rotation-20251104.csv)."
Sara — Solutions: I'll shorten for the SIG: "Data at-rest: AES-256; customer-managed KMS supported; rotation logs available (artifact: kms-rotation-20251104.csv)."
Ben R.: Perfect. @Marie — flag any remaining questions without artifacts so we can schedule a brief capture call with the customer.
Marie K.: Flagged: Q-B7 (penetration test report) — we have a high-level summary but the full pentest is under NDA with vendor. I set note: "summary provided; full report available under NDA; contact security@redwood.com"
Luis Ops: FYI one artifact had sensitive IPs — I redacted the PDF and reuploaded as vpc-arch-public.pdf. Old file moved to s3://redwood-sales/acme/arch/private/vpc-arch-original.pdf
Ben R.: Thanks. Last ask — pricing/POC note: Acme asked about Dedicated latency SLAs for production. Can someone paste the SLA line?
Sara — Solutions: "Dedicated offers 99.9% uptime SLA with latency SLOs configurable by instance type; see dedicated-sla.pdf attached."
Marie K.: Manifest final, pushed with links and a small README. Sharing bundle to Acme via secure link shortly.
Ben R.: Thanks team — I'll send the SIG responses + bundle to the customer and mark the thread resolved. :thumbsup:
Marie K.: Resolving — will follow up if they ask for the NDA for pentest. :eyes:
